basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Investor, Operator & AI Engineer | 22% CAGR (USD) / 13 Years | Portfolio Value Creation, PE-Owned Product Leadership, Founder-CEO Diligence
basics.summary: 13 years ago I started my own portfolio and never stopped optimizing it for performance and value creation: 22% CAGR (USD) across cycles, with high-conviction positions in Anthropic ($18B round), SpaceX ($125B round), Indian consumer/financial/IT compounders and a Ray Dalio-informed risk framework. Operator side: Lead AI Engineer at LumApps (Bridgepoint-owned PE portfolio company), driving GTM AI that 2x conversions and forecasts $1M/quarter in revenue. Founded 3 companies, ran 6 years of hands-on product/data engineering at Beekeeper ($1.5M+ revenue channel built, $337K in vendor cost cut), and mentor buy-side / fintech founders at Tenity including Opt Alpha (algo trading). Unconventional profile: I bring the investor lens, the operator scars and an AI leverage layer that most PE value-creation officers cannot.

work.name: LumApps (Bridgepoint-owned)
work.position: Lead AI Engineer & GTM AI Advisor
highlights: Operate inside a Bridgepoint PE portfolio company. Own the GTM AI thesis end-to-end: production multi-agent workflows that 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities and forecast $4M/quarter pipeline (~$1M revenue at 25% conversion). Report directly to C-level on value-creation outcomes.

Consult with commercial leadership on how AI compounds sales productivity across the portfolio: measurable rep-hour savings (2 to 3 hours per rep per day), cost-per-request instrumentation and value-creation KPIs the PE owner can underwrite.

Architected AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph unifying Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts and product usage. Same playbook I would use to build a shared performance-and-diligence layer across an investment group's portfolio.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Architected Employee Referral System end-to-end, reporting to CIO: became the platform's top revenue channel with $1.5M+ generated and $500K ARR at 99.99% SLA. Ran the business case, the tech and the GTM with Sales and PM.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor cost with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. Direct P&L impact, rigorous payback analysis, ruthless prioritization.

Co-owned GTM launches with Product and Sales (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis). Each shipped with instrumentation so we could challenge assumptions and know within a week whether the initiative moved the metric.
Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams; mentored the AI engineering cohort; global on-call. Practical, hands-on operator across product, engineering and commercial.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Portfolio-style diligence on 20+ fintech and AI startups for seed-to-VC investment decisions: business model, moat, unit economics, governance and ESG readiness. Challenged founders and CFOs on the numbers, not just the story.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling algorithmic trading in production. Advised multiple portfolio companies on operating rhythm, hiring and value-creating AI adoption.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer at an EPFL spin-off. Built the commercial platform that ran 500+ real-world deliveries and enabled partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase. Ownership over product, tech and enterprise commercials.
First-hand experience of logistics, last-mile trade and industrial operations: exactly the kind of hands-on operating context Ampersand's portfolio touches (logistics, trade, industrial businesses).

projects.name: Personal Investing Track Record - 22% CAGR (USD), 13 Years
projects.description: 13+ years managing my own multi-asset portfolio for performance and value creation. 22% CAGR (USD) across cycles, with disciplined position sizing and drawdown control. Notable high-conviction positions: Anthropic (entered at $18B round), SpaceX (entered at $125B round) and Indian consumer / financial / IT compounders as a core EM sleeve. Risk framework informed by Ray Dalio's Principles and Big Debt Crises. Every position underwritten with a written thesis on business model, moat, unit economics, capital allocation and governance, with pre-defined invalidation triggers.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence & Algo Trading
projects.description: Production AI platform I built for my own portfolio first, then opened to retail. Ingests price and news time series, runs technical + sentiment signals, and executes rules-based algo strategies with agents that generate AND justify every signal (if the model cannot explain it, it does not ship). Explainability, evaluation and back-testing baked in. Living proof that AI can compound an investor's edge without giving up governance.

projects.name: Anand Creations - Forward Deployed Engineering Practice
